text:
Mei: FYI brought aegis-lite-q4 into canary today for multilang smoke. Seeing weird CJK + RTL bracket mirroring in outputs :confused:
Sam: paste a tiny repro?
Mei: Repro (canary):
```
Input: 翻译: (测试) 你好
Output: （テスト) 你好
```
Mei: For Arabic prompt it actually mirrors the paren and moves it:
```
Input: ترجمة: (اختبار) مرحبا
Output: )اختبار( مرحبا
```
Jordan: that second one looks like parentheses got mirrored+reordered — bidi/normalization/detok issue not pure model hallucination. Did quant change tokenizer or detokenizer mapping?
Lia: I ran a quick compare vs aegis-base (fp16) on same prompt: fp16 returns: "(اختبار) مرحبا" (unchanged). So issue introduced somewhere in quant build or postproc.
Mei: Checked raw tokens from the canary run: token sequence near parens is different (U+0028 vs U+FF08 variants). Token IDs printed below:
```
fp16 token ids: 40 1023 17 ...
q4 token ids: 40 65231 17 ...
```
Sam: 65231 is a high id — might be from fallback subtokenization or an index remap after quant packing. Can you dump tokenizer vocab slice around those ids?
Mei: attaching quick dump in logs channel but short view: q4 seems to map fullwidth paren variants to the wrong glyph class during detok.
Jordan: Could be two things: 1) tokenizer pretokenize changed (maybe we used different normalizer for canary pipeline), or 2) int4 packing/fast-detok kernels introduced a codepath that normalizes parentheses using Unicode bidi mirrors.
Lia: eval-bot reported BLEU drop on zh->en smallset: -3.2 on canary vs baseline. Most diffs cluster around punctuation and bracketed phrases.
Mei: Action plan: (1) reproduce deterministically outside runtime (CPU fp16 vs quantized offline detok), (2) run bisect on tokenization commit range (last tokenizer change rolled 1769005000..1769790000), (3) pin aegis-lite-q4 canary to fallback detok implementation until root cause found, (4) add a focused test for bracket mirroring across RTL locales.
Sam: I'll spin up a minimal repro: run tokenization/detok on CPU with the quantized vocab mapping and compare U+ codepoints. Sharing command:
```bash
PYTHONPATH=./build:./tools python tools/token_debug.py --model aegis-lite-q4 --text "ترجمة: (اختبار)" --dump-ids --detok-mode fast
```
Jordan: good. If fast detok kernel is the suspect, switch to safe detok for canary via feature-flag and re-run eval-bot. That should buy time.
Mei: Enabled fallback detok flag on canary (rollout 10%) and requeued the zh/en eval set. eval-bot will post results when done.
Lia: Also adding a small unit test in tokenizers repo for mixed-direction bracket cases (CJK + Arabic) — low cost and should catch regressions.
Mei: Rough timeline: repro + bisect today, fallback flag remains until next deploy; will open a short PR if we confirm kernel bug.
Sam: If bisect points to quant packing, we should try rebuilding with alternate packing alignment (q8->q4 layout variant) — that changed indices for a few vocab subranges in the last release.
Jordan: Noted. Ping me when bisect job completes. If it's tokenizer, we patch normalizer and push a hotfix.
Mei: Thanks — I'll post minimal failing examples and eval diffs when available. :thumbsup:
